definitions.plain_definition: Able to be examined or checked carefully so that you can see all its parts and how it works.
definitions.used_in_context: The goal is to make every claim inspectable.

definitions.plain_definition: The part of an idea or argument that holds up the rest of it, like a wall that supports a roof.
definitions.used_in_context: It turns a claim around until every load-bearing surface is visible.

definitions.plain_definition: Assumes something is true before you even start talking about it.
definitions.used_in_context: Ask what the claim already presupposes about reality, language, and method.

definitions.plain_definition: The specific tests or situations that would prove an idea is wrong if they failed.
definitions.used_in_context: List the tests that would break the claim if they failed honestly.
